text_sample: I've spent over a decade designing digital products — at agencies, scale-ups, and now independently.The best apps aren't the most complex ones. They're the ones that get out of the way.
The best apps aren't the most complex ones. They're the ones that get out of the way.

Before starting Formo, I spent eight years at companies like Uber, Booking.com, and Fabrique — learning how to solve complex problems under real constraints. I bring that same rigour to every project I take on today.
I remove everything that doesn't serve the goal. No noise, no decoration — just focused design that communicates instantly and clearly.
I'd rather take an extra week to get the details right than ship something almost good enough. The difference is always in the last 10%.
Trends fade. I design apps and systems that hold up over time — not because they follow rules, but because they're rooted in something real.
Great work happens when designers, developers, and clients think together — not in silos. I involve you at every stage, not just the kickoff.

Enable JavaScript to submit this form.
Most projects take 4–8 weeks depending on scope. A brand identity usually runs 4–6 weeks, while a full website can take 6–8 weeks from kickoff to launch.
We work with fixed project fees, not hourly rates. After an intro call we'll send a clear proposal with scope, timeline, and cost — no surprises.
What do you need from me to get started?
A short brief helps — your goals, timeline, and budget range. If you don't have one, no problem. We'll figure it out together on a free intro call.
Do you work with startups or only established brands?
Both. We've helped early-stage startups define their first brand identity and worked with scaling companies on redesigns. What matters is ambition, not company size.
Do you offer ongoing support after launch?
Yes. We offer monthly retainer packages for brands that need continuous design support, updates, or new assets after the initial project wraps.

text_sample: This Privacy Policy explains how Formo collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you visit our website or contact us through our platform.
When you use our contact form or reach out directly, we may collect:
Project details and any other information included in your message
When you visit our website, we may automatically collect:
Pages visited and time spent on each page
We use the information collected to:
Respond to inquiries and project requests
Communicate about potential or ongoing projects
Improve our website performance and user experience
Analyze website traffic and usage patterns
Ensure the security and stability of our platform
We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. We may share your data only in the following circumstances:
With trusted service providers who assist in operating our website (such as hosting or analytics providers), bound by confidentiality obligations
When required by law, regulation, or legal process
To protect the rights, safety, or property of Formo or others
We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience. For detailed information about the types of cookies we use and how to manage them, please refer to our Cookie Policy.

We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, or as required by law. Contact form submissions are retained for up to 12 months unless an ongoing project relationship exists.
